notes.title: The problem of black screen
notes.notes:
At present, the problem of black screen has been solved. Players who still have CG occlusion problem (or file loss) should download the game again.

Re-install the game method: right-click the game in STEM library, click uninstall, and then download it again.

In addition, this update has repaired some wearing problems and BUG. Thank you for your feedback.
